$schema: Example in examples/ for crawler.py --advisories (GHSA-479c-33wc-g2pg / CVE-2026-23869).
_instructions: When creating NEW advisory files (e.g. via Cursor/AI), name them: advisories_<library>_<id>.json — library = short npm-related name (lowercase, underscores); id = CVE-2026-12345 or GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx if no CVE yet. Examples: advisories_axios_CVE-2026-25639.json, advisories_nextjs_GHSA-q4gf-8mx6-v5v3.json. Bundled templates use the .example.json suffix; drop .example for your own copies.

react-server-dom-webpack.title: Denial of Service in React Server Components (react-server-dom-webpack)
react-server-dom-webpack.notes: DoS via crafted HTTP requests to Server Function endpoints. Patched: 19.0.5, 19.1.6, 19.2.5. Only affects apps using RSC with a supported bundler integration.

react-server-dom-parcel.title: Denial of Service in React Server Components (react-server-dom-parcel)
react-server-dom-parcel.notes: Same advisory as react-server-dom-webpack; use fixed line versions 19.0.5, 19.1.6, or 19.2.5+.

react-server-dom-turbopack.title: Denial of Service in React Server Components (react-server-dom-turbopack)
react-server-dom-turbopack.notes: Same advisory as react-server-dom-webpack; use fixed line versions 19.0.5, 19.1.6, or 19.2.5+.
